about: Public BloombergNEF Electric Vehicle Outlook 2025 executive summary, page 2, https://assets.bbhub.io/professional/sites/24/202506-EVO2025-Executive-Summary.pdf (reviewed 2026-11-15). The figures belong to BloombergNEF, not IEA. Both attribution controls use the same figure and passage. A real report used this PDF as an IEA executive-summary copy.

findings.title: Electric Vehicle Outlook 2025 - BloombergNEF
findings.content: © Bloomberg Finance L.P. 2025. Electric Vehicle Outlook 2025. Source: BloombergNEF. Global passenger EV sales rise from 17.6 million in 2024 to over 39 million in 2030 in this year's outlook.

claims.claim: The IEA Global EV Outlook 2025 projects global passenger EV sales above 39 million in 2030.
BloombergNEF's Electric Vehicle Outlook 2025 projects global passenger EV sales above 39 million in 2030.
